name: Reproduce and report a web bug

spec.purpose: Reproduce a reported web defect, capture evidence, and draft a bug report; ask before filing externally.
trigger_conditions: User reports a defect in a web page they can reach
prerequisites: Page reachable from the computer service
fixture_tracker (or other tracker) connection for filing

args.name: bug-report.md
args.content: steps, expected, actual, console errors, screenshot id

failure_handling: If sign-in is required, stop and ask for a human takeover
Never retry a submission whose outcome is unknown
spec.output_contract: bug-report.md + screenshot + tracker issue id (after approval)
